name: SAMPLE - Lead Intake (Dedupe to Table + Notify)

parameters.content:
## Lead Intake — sample build
**Config step first:** all environment values (notify URL, file path) live in `1. Config` only.
**Rate-limit design:** one summary notification per run — never one call per lead.
**Stand-ins in this sample:** workflow memory + CSV snapshot = the buyer's Sheet/CRM; local echo endpoint = Slack/email.
